questions.text: docs/WORKFLOW.md, the routing section ('The routing'), the row whose first cell reads 'Repair after 4b and 6': give the primary repair model's exact identifier as written in that row's model cell.
The same 'Repair after 4b and 6' row names the model that takes over after two failed checks: give that fallback model's exact name, without its effort text.
scripts/verify_lock.py assigns the default memory floor to the constant DEFAULT_MEMORY_FLOOR: give that floor as a number in percent, without an environment override.
scripts/verify_lock.py assigns the memory floor's environment override to the constant FLOOR_ENV: give that environment variable's exact name.
docs/orchestration.md, the section 'What a lane is', links dated run plans: give the one repository-relative directory those links resolve into (a trailing slash is optional).

docs/WORKFLOW.md, the section 'The eighth movement: the session handover', gives the handover artefact's dated path (<date>-<name>.md): give the repository-relative directory of that path (a trailing slash is optional).
AGENTS.md carries a house rule of the form 'Use ..., never bare ...' for the tracker: give the repository-relative tracker executable exactly as that rule writes it.
Give the name of the sole repository instruction file, as declared in its opening.
